title: Harborline Cloud 8 Upgrade Charge: Method of Calculation
content:
Billing operations — how the Harborline Cloud 8 upgrade charge on a Web Hosting Plans plan is worked out.

**1. The charge.** The Cloud 8 upgrade charge is the Cloud 8 term price minus the amount paid for the current term, multiplied by the remaining days and divided by the term days, rounded half up to the cent and never below zero.

**2. Cloud 8 term price.** Harborline Cloud 8's rate for the plan's current term length multiplied by its months:

| Plan's current term | Current term is the plan's first term | Current term is not the first term |
|---|---|---|
| 12 months | USD 44.99 per month, multiplied by 12 | USD 89.99 per month, multiplied by 12 |
| 24 months | USD 39.99 per month, multiplied by 24 | USD 79.99 per month, multiplied by 24 |
| 36 months | USD 34.99 per month, multiplied by 36 | USD 69.99 per month, multiplied by 36 |
| 1 month | USD 104.99, once | USD 104.99, once |

These are the Cloud 8 introductory, regular and 1-month prices. The current term is the plan's first term when the line that paid the current term is the plan's initial term line. The Cloud 8 term price takes no account tier discount and the new term price description of the hosting upgrade terms does not apply to it, because the Harborline Customer Accounts charter never applies a tier discount to proration lines.

**3. Amount paid for the current term.** The amount of the renewal line paid at checkout whose period start equals the plan's term start date; or, when there is none, of the auto-renew line with that period start; or, when there is neither, of the plan's initial term line with that period start (a refunded line is always an auto-renew line, because a renewal the customer paid manually is never refundable) — plus any earlier upgrade proration lines whose period end equals the plan's term end date.

**4. Days.** Remaining days are the calendar days from today to the term end date; term days are the calendar days from the term start date to the term end date.

**5. Assembly.** Credits are fixed amounts in USD that are never discounted: the Cloud 8 upgrade charge is the prorated charge less the credits, rounded half up to the cent, and the credits together never take more than half of the prorated charge.

**Worked example (hypothetical dates and amount paid).** A Harborline Cloud 4 plan on a 12-month term from 10 March 2030 to 10 March 2031, paid by an auto-renew line of USD 512.40; today is 22 November 2030. The term is not the first term, so the Cloud 8 term price is 89.99 multiplied by 12, USD 1079.88. The difference is USD 567.48; remaining days 108, term days 365; prorated charge 167.9119, rounded to USD 167.91. Had the amount paid exceeded the Cloud 8 term price, the charge would be zero.
